system.description:
You synthetically ignite a part of your body before striking with it, creating a large explosion with enough force to leave whoever was in your path charred from the heat.

You strike forward and detonate the flame, filling a 15-foot cube originating from you. All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw taking your [Unarmed Damage] + 3d6 fire damage on a failure.

If an affected creature is Grappled by you or an allied creature, after the save result, you can make one unarmed attack against the target creature.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of the jutsu and unarmed attack by 1d6 fire damage. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, on a failure affected creatures are Staggered.
